n = int(input())
B = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
pq = []
import heapq

evenCount = 0
oddCount = 0
for i in range(n - 1):
    if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    if evenCount == oddCount:
        heapq.heappush(pq, abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]))

result = 0
while B >= 0 and pq:
    B -= heapq.heappop(pq)
    if B < 0:
        break
    result += 1

print(result)
